articles.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
articles.description: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
articles.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
articles.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
articles.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
articles.description: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
articles.description: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
articles.description: Watch as Wiz CTO Tomer Schwartz joins the Equity podcast to break down how AI is changing vulnerability research and how startups can prepare for the next security scare.

articles.title: The ‘Vulnpocalypse’ is coming for the internet’s aging code, says Wiz’s CTO
articles.description: On Equity, Wiz’s Tomer Schwartz explains how AI is changing vulnerability research, why coordinated disclosure is so difficult, and how startups can prepare for the next security scare.

articles.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
articles.description: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
articles.description: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
articles.author: Sarah Perez
